normalize_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_locations: remove all file location info from a Google Test program output using regex substitution
remove_stack_trace_details: replace stack trace blocks in test output with a placeholder omitted message
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified tests from Google Test output by matching a regex pattern
get_shell_command_output: run a shell command in a subprocess and return its combined standard and diagnostic output
